typography.heading_treatment: Libre Baskerville at display scale — H1 at 48–60px, H2 at 32–40px, H3 at 22–26px — set in sentence case with tight tracking (-0.02em) and strong weight contrast between regular and bold cuts. The high-contrast serif bracketing evokes the physical weight of a notarized document, reinforcing the skeuomorphic material register. Headlines on dark surfaces use Inlaid Cream; headlines on light surfaces use Vault Slate.
typography.body_treatment: Source Sans 3 at 16–18px with a 1.65 line-height and a comfortable 60–72ch measure. The clean, open humanist sans provides legibility and warmth for longer editorial copy, service descriptions, and card body text without competing with the serif heading hierarchy. Body text is set in Vault Slate on light surfaces and Inlaid Cream on dark panels.
typography.accent_treatment: Montserrat at 10–13px, all-caps, with wide letter-spacing (0.12–0.18em) and medium weight — used exclusively for eyebrow labels above section headings, card category tags, badge text, form field labels, and metadata captions. This small-UI role reinforces the skeuomorphic control-panel aesthetic without ever appearing at display scale.

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
## Home Page — Full Design Direction

### Page Role & Goal
This is the landing page for Hearthstone Law, a boutique estate planning firm. Every design decision must immediately communicate trust, warmth, permanence, and legal authority. The page converts first-time visitors into consultation bookings by moving them through an emotional arc: attention → orientation → social proof → action.

---

### Signature Moment
**The hero's oversized embossed display word "LEGACY" — rendered in Polished Brass (#B08A4E) at ~160–180px, Libre Baskerville bold, set behind the hero headline as a typographic watermark anchoring the composition.** It bleeds off the right edge of the hero panel, partially cropped, sitting at roughly 40% opacity so it reads as a material impression pressed into the Vault Slate surface — like a notarial seal or a letterpress plate. This is the page's unmistakable skeuomorphic-modern signature: type used as material texture, not just communication. It belongs to this aesthetic because skeuomorphic design treats surfaces as physical objects with embedded marks, stamps, and impressions. It belongs to this brand because "legacy" is the firm's core promise. It lives in Section 1 (hero) and sets the tonal register for everything that follows.

---

### Section Sequence & Rhythm
1. **Hero (Section 1):** Maximum density, dark surface, full-bleed. The page opens at its heaviest visual weight — Vault Slate panel, the embossed "LEGACY" watermark, serif headline at display scale, the protective-home illustration anchored bottom-right overlapping the panel edge. Asymmetric left-aligned text column occupying ~55% of width.
2. **Feature Grid (Section 2):** Shift to the warm Hearthstone Linen surface. Four service cards arranged in a 2×2 grid with strong skeuomorphic card depth — raised Inlaid Cream surfaces, Polished Brass border accents, Chambered Shadow drop shadows. Moderate density with breathing room between cards. Section header is left-aligned, not centered.
3. **Testimonials (Section 3):** A full-bleed Notary Sage (#4A5E52) dark-mid panel that breaks the linen/dark alternation and introduces a third surface color. Cards are horizontal scroll tiles on mobile, three-column on desktop. Pull-quote marks in Polished Brass at oversized scale (120px) anchor each card as a skeuomorphic material ornament. This is the densest typographic section.
4. **CTA (Section 4):** Return to Vault Slate dark surface for closure and authority. Centered composition — justified by the heritage-adjacent legal gravitas of a closing statement. Sparse, high-contrast, with a single brass CTA button and a decorative horizontal rule in Polished Brass above and below the headline.

### Density / Whitespace Logic
- Hero: tight internal padding (64px top/bottom), content fills the stage
- Feature Grid: generous card gutters (32px), section padding 80px top/bottom
- Testimonials: 64px vertical padding, cards have internal 32px padding
- CTA: maximum whitespace (96px top/bottom), minimal content — the sparseness is intentional and signals resolution

### Color Surface Usage Across Sections
- Section 1: Vault Slate (#2C3340) background, Inlaid Cream text, Polished Brass watermark + CTAs
- Section 2: Hearthstone Linen (#F2EDE6) background, Inlaid Cream card faces, Polished Brass card borders + CTA
- Section 3: Notary Sage (#4A5E52) background, Inlaid Cream card faces, Polished Brass quote marks
- Section 4: Vault Slate (#2C3340) background, Inlaid Cream text, Polished Brass rule + CTA button

### Typographic Hierarchy
- Display watermark: Libre Baskerville Bold, 160–180px, Polished Brass at 40% opacity
- H1: Libre Baskerville Bold, 52–60px, Inlaid Cream, -0.02em tracking
- H2: Libre Baskerville Regular, 36–40px, Vault Slate (on light) / Inlaid Cream (on dark)
- H3 (card titles): Libre Baskerville Bold, 22–24px
- Body: Source Sans 3, 17px, 1.65 line-height
- Eyebrow/labels: Montserrat, 11px, all-caps, 0.15em letter-spacing
- Card metadata: Montserrat, 10px, Brushed Pewter

### Responsive Behavior
- Hero: stacks vertically on mobile, illustration moves behind text at 60% opacity as a background layer; watermark scales to 80px and remains partially cropped right
- Feature Grid: 2×2 on desktop/tablet, single column on mobile with full-width cards
- Testimonials: 3-column on desktop, horizontal scroll snap on tablet, single column on mobile
- CTA: always centered, scales padding down to 64px on mobile

### Shared Design System Fit
All fonts (Libre Baskerville, Source Sans 3, Montserrat), all color tokens, and all surface logic follow the shared design system exactly. The skeuomorphic card system — Inlaid Cream face, Chambered Shadow drop shadow, Polished Brass edge accent, subtle inner highlight on top edge — is used consistently across Sections 2 and 3 as the page's repeating material motif.

section_design_plans.nl_prompt:
SECTION 1 — HERO

Surface & Background: Full-bleed Vault Slate (#2C3340) panel. No image background — the surface is a flat, deep, material slab that reads as a heavy legal binder cover. Minimum height: 100vh on desktop, auto on mobile.

Signature Moment — Embossed Display Watermark: Set the word 'LEGACY' in Libre Baskerville Bold at approximately 170px, colored Polished Brass (#B08A4E) at 38–42% opacity. Position it absolutely, right-aligned, vertically centered in the panel, cropped at the right edge so roughly 30% of the word bleeds off-screen. It sits behind all foreground content (z-index below text and illustration) and functions as a letterpress impression into the dark surface — a material mark, not a decorative flourish. This is the page's primary signature moment.

Layout: Two-column asymmetric split on desktop. Left column: 55% width, left-aligned, contains all text content and CTAs. Right column: 45% width, holds the illustration asset anchored to the bottom-right of the hero, overlapping the bottom edge of the panel by approximately 40px into Section 2 — this overlap creates the skeuomorphic sense of a three-dimensional object sitting on top of the page surface.

Eyebrow: Montserrat, 11px, all-caps, letter-spacing 0.15em, Polished Brass (#B08A4E). Text: 'Estate Planning Attorneys'. Positioned 64px from the top of the content area. A thin 1px horizontal rule in Polished Brass, 40px wide, precedes the eyebrow text on the same line (rule → 12px gap → label).

Headline: Libre Baskerville Bold, 54px on desktop / 38px on mobile, Inlaid Cream (#FAF7F2), -0.02em tracking, sentence case. Line breaks after 'Built.' for visual rhythm. Max-width: 560px.

Subheadline: Source Sans 3, 18px, 1.65 line-height, Brushed Pewter (#8E9199). Max-width: 480px. 24px margin-top from headline.

CTA Row: Two buttons, 40px margin-top. Primary: 'Schedule a Free Consultation' — pill-shaped button, Polished Brass (#B08A4E) fill, Vault Slate text, Montserrat 12px all-caps 0.12em tracking, 16px vertical / 32px horizontal padding, subtle inner top-edge highlight (1px rgba-white at 20%) to simulate a raised physical button — the skeuomorphic control aesthetic. Secondary: 'Explore Our Services' — ghost button, 1.5px Inlaid Cream border, Inlaid Cream text, same type treatment, same padding. 20px gap between buttons.

Illustration Asset: The stylized house-with-shield-and-scroll illustration is placed in the right column, bottom-aligned, approximately 420px tall on desktop. It overlaps the hero's bottom border by ~40px, floating above Section 2's linen surface. The illustration should feel like a physical object placed on the page — apply a Chambered Shadow (#1A1E26) drop shadow at 0px 12px 40px 0px, 30% opacity beneath it. On mobile, the illustration scales to 200px, centered, sits below the CTA row, and is tinted at 50% opacity so it reads as a background flourish rather than a competing element.

Spacing: 64px top padding, 80px bottom padding on desktop. On mobile: 48px top, 40px bottom.

SECTION 2 — FEATURE GRID (What We Do)

Surface & Background: Hearthstone Linen (#F2EDE6) — the warm tactile paper base. Full-width section. The hero illustration from Section 1 overlaps into this section's top by ~40px (handled by Section 1's overflow), so this section's top padding is 80px to accommodate that overlap without crowding.

Section Header Block: Left-aligned, not centered. Occupies the left ~60% of the container width.
- Eyebrow: Montserrat, 11px, all-caps, 0.15em letter-spacing, Notary Sage (#4A5E52). Text: 'What We Do'. 80px from section top.
- Headline: Libre Baskerville Regular, 38px, Vault Slate (#2C3340), -0.02em tracking. Text: 'Comprehensive Estate Planning Under One Roof'. Max-width: 560px.
- Subheadline: Source Sans 3, 17px, Brushed Pewter (#8E9199), 1.65 line-height. Text: 'From simple wills to complex trust structures, we guide you through every step.' Max-width: 480px. 16px margin-top.
- 40px gap between header block and card grid.

Card Grid: 2×2 grid on desktop (two columns, two rows), 32px column and row gutters. Each card is a raised Inlaid Cream (#FAF7F2) surface with the following skeuomorphic material treatment:
- Background: Inlaid Cream (#FAF7F2)
- Border: 1.5px solid Polished Brass (#B08A4E) on left edge only (4px wide left-border accent strip in Polished Brass, full card height) — this highlighted edge accent is the skeuomorphic depth cue, simulating a brass binding strip on a legal folder
- Drop shadow: Chambered Shadow (#1A1E26) at 0px 8px 28px 0px, 18% opacity
- Inner top highlight: 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.45) line at top edge to simulate a lit surface
- Border-radius: 6px
- Internal padding: 32px all sides

Card Content (per card):
- Category icon: A simple 28px line-art icon in Notary Sage (#4A5E52), top-left of card content area. Icons: document with quill (Wills), nested circles/shield (Trusts), handshake (Powers of Attorney), medical cross/heart (Healthcare Directives).
- Title: Libre Baskerville Bold, 22px, Vault Slate (#2C3340), 16px margin-top from icon.
- Description: Source Sans 3, 16px, Brushed Pewter (#8E9199), 1.65 line-height, 10px margin-top from title.

Cards in order (left-to-right, top-to-bottom): Wills & Testaments, Revocable Living Trusts, Powers of Attorney, Healthcare Directives.

CTA Below Grid: 'See All Services' — left-aligned, 40px margin-top from grid. Ghost button with 1.5px Polished Brass border, Polished Brass text, Montserrat 11px all-caps 0.12em tracking, 14px vertical / 28px horizontal padding. On hover: fills with Polished Brass, text becomes Vault Slate.

Bottom padding: 80px.

Responsive: On tablet, grid remains 2×2 with reduced gutters (20px). On mobile, single column, full-width cards, 20px gutters, CTA becomes full-width.

SECTION 3 — TESTIMONIALS (Client Stories)

Surface & Background: Full-bleed Notary Sage (#4A5E52) panel. This is a deliberate break from the linen/slate alternation — the muted professional green reads as a third material layer, like aged bookcloth on a legal volume. It creates mid-page contrast and signals 'human stories' rather than 'firm information.'

Section Header Block: Left-aligned within the container.
- Eyebrow: Montserrat, 11px, all-caps, 0.15em letter-spacing, Polished Brass (#B08A4E). Text: 'Client Stories'. 64px from section top.
- Headline: Libre Baskerville Bold, 36px, Inlaid Cream (#FAF7F2), -0.02em tracking. Text: 'Families Who Found Peace of Mind'. Max-width: 520px. 12px margin-top from eyebrow.
- 40px gap between header and card row.

Testimonial Cards: Three cards in a single horizontal row, equal-width columns (3-column grid, 28px gutters). Each card is a raised Inlaid Cream (#FAF7F2) surface:
- Background: Inlaid Cream (#FAF7F2)
- Border-radius: 6px
- Drop shadow: Chambered Shadow (#1A1E26) at 0px 10px 36px 0px, 25% opacity
- Inner top highlight: 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.5) at top edge
- Internal padding: 36px 32px 32px 32px

Card Content (per card):
- Oversized Opening Quote Mark: Libre Baskerville Bold, 96px, Polished Brass (#B08A4E), positioned at the very top-left of the card's content area, line-height 1, margin-bottom -20px (so it tucks into the quote text visually, as if it's part of the same typographic block). This is the section's material ornament — a physical quotation mark pressed into the card surface at display scale.
- Quote Text: Source Sans 3, 16px, Vault Slate (#2C3340), 1.65 line-height, italic style. The full quote text from each item's description field.
- Divider: 1px Brushed Pewter (#8E9199) rule, 100% card width, 24px margin-top and bottom.
- Attribution: Montserrat, 10px, all-caps, 0.14em letter-spacing, Brushed Pewter (#8E9199). The item title field (e.g., 'Margaret & Thomas R., Retired Educators').

Cards in order: Margaret & Thomas R., David K., Sandra L.

Bottom padding: 64px.

Responsive: On tablet, cards become horizontal scroll with snap-scroll, each card 80vw wide with 16px gap, partially revealing the next card. On mobile, single column full-width cards with 20px vertical gap.

No CTA in this section — the testimonials close with the attribution and let the next section carry the conversion action. The silence after the quotes is intentional.

SECTION 4 — CTA (Take the First Step)

Surface & Background: Vault Slate (#2C3340) full-bleed panel. This mirrors the hero's dark surface and creates a bookend composition — the page opens and closes on the same material, giving the visitor a sense of resolution and return.

Layout: Fully centered composition — justified here because this is the closing statement of the page, analogous to a notarized closing clause on a legal document. Maximum whitespace: 96px top and bottom padding.

Ornamental Rule System (skeuomorphic material detail): A horizontal decorative rule structure frames the headline block:
- Top: A 1px Polished Brass (#B08A4E) rule, 200px wide, centered, 0px above the eyebrow. Then 24px gap.
- Bottom: Same 1px Polished Brass rule, 200px wide, centered, 24px below the CTA button.
These rules function as a pair of brass binding bars — a skeuomorphic ornamental device that treats the CTA block as a framed, stamped document panel.

Eyebrow: Montserrat, 11px, all-caps, 0.15em letter-spacing, Polished Brass (#B08A4E). Text: 'Take the First Step'. Centered. 24px below the top rule.

Headline: Libre Baskerville Bold, 44px on desktop / 32px on mobile, Inlaid Cream (#FAF7F2), -0.02em tracking, centered. Text: 'Your Estate Plan Starts with a Conversation'. Max-width: 600px, centered. 16px margin-top from eyebrow.

Subheadline: Source Sans 3, 18px, Brushed Pewter (#8E9199), 1.65 line-height, centered. Text: 'Schedule a complimentary 30-minute consultation and discover exactly what your family needs to be protected.' Max-width: 520px, centered. 20px margin-top from headline.

CTA Button: Single button, centered, 36px margin-top. 'Book Your Free Consultation' — Polished Brass (#B08A4E) fill, Vault Slate (#2C3340) text, Montserrat 12px all-caps 0.12em tracking, 18px vertical / 40px horizontal padding, 6px border-radius. Skeuomorphic button treatment: 1px inner top highlight rgba(255,255,255,0.22), subtle bottom inner shadow rgba(0,0,0,0.18) to simulate a physically pressable surface. On hover: brightness increases 8%, shadow deepens slightly.

Spacing: The entire content block (rule → eyebrow → headline → subheadline → CTA → rule) is vertically centered within the section. The sparseness of this section — only these elements on a dark field — is the design's final move: restraint as authority.

Responsive: Padding reduces to 72px top/bottom on tablet, 56px on mobile. Rules scale to 120px wide on mobile. Headline scales to 30px. Subheadline scales to 16px.

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
The About page for Hearthstone Law is a skeuomorphic-modern editorial composition that prioritizes material depth, typographic authority, and human warmth over the generic marketing template. The page moves through four sections with deliberately varied skeleton structures — no two sections share the same compositional logic — creating an alternating dense/sparse rhythm that rewards reading while never feeling padded.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The page-defining visual move lives in the Story Block (Section 2). Eleanor Marsh's founding narrative is set inside a full-bleed Vault Slate (#2C3340) panel that spans the entire viewport width. Embedded within this dark surface is an oversized display pull-quote — a single sentence fragment from the body copy rendered in Libre Baskerville at 72–80px, set in Polished Brass (#B08A4E), that bleeds slightly off the right grid boundary. The skeuomorphic timeline illustration is inset into the left half of this panel as a raised, cream-bordered document card with a visible drop shadow (Chambered Shadow #1A1E26 at 24px blur), making it read as a physical artifact resting on the dark surface. This is the inevitable skeuomorphic-modern signature: a physical document object sitting on a dark authoritative ground, with the accent color carrying typographic weight rather than merely marking buttons.

SECTION SEQUENCE AND RHYTHM:
1. Page Header — Sparse, centered masthead treatment on Inlaid Cream (#FAF7F2). Tall vertical breathing room. No card grid. Sets an editorial, document-like tone.
2. Story Block — Full-bleed Vault Slate panel, asymmetric two-column split (illustration card left / editorial text right), oversized Polished Brass pull-quote as the signature moment. Maximum density and drama.
3. Team Grid — Returns to Hearthstone Linen (#F2EDE6) base. Three raised attorney profile cards in a horizontal grid, each with skeuomorphic depth (highlighted top edge in Inlaid Cream, Chambered Shadow drop shadow). Moderate density with generous internal card padding. Human and warm.
4. Values Feature Grid — Notary Sage (#4A5E52) accent panel header row above a 2×2 card grid on Inlaid Cream. Compact, structured, ends with a single centered Polished Brass CTA button as a terminal close.

COLOR SURFACE LOGIC: The page alternates between light and dark surfaces — Inlaid Cream (Section 1) → Vault Slate (Section 2) → Hearthstone Linen (Section 3) → Inlaid Cream with Notary Sage header accent (Section 4). Polished Brass appears as pull-quote display type in Section 2, as card border highlights in Section 3, and as the CTA button in Section 4. Brushed Pewter (#8E9199) is used consistently for metadata labels, role tags, and body copy secondary hierarchy. Chambered Shadow is used exclusively for deep drop shadows beneath all raised card elements.

TYPOGRAPHIC HIERARCHY: Libre Baskerville carries all H1–H3 headlines. Montserrat in all-caps with 0.14em tracking handles all eyebrow labels and card role badges. Source Sans 3 carries body copy and card descriptions. The signature Polished Brass oversized pull-quote in Section 2 is the one moment where Libre Baskerville operates at display scale (72–80px) outside of a conventional headline role — this is intentional and unrepeated elsewhere on the page.

SKEUOMORPHIC MATERIAL SYSTEM: Every card surface uses a three-layer depth treatment — Inlaid Cream face, a 1px highlighted top/left edge in a lighter tint, and a Chambered Shadow drop shadow at 16–24px blur, 4–8px Y-offset. Divider rules between sections use a 1px Brushed Pewter hairline with a subtle 2px Polished Brass dot-center ornament at the midpoint, functioning as a structural device rather than decoration.

DENSITY / WHITESPACE LOGIC: Section 1 is maximally sparse (large vertical padding, centered single-column text). Section 2 is maximally dense (full-bleed dark panel, two-column split, oversized type, illustration card). Section 3 is moderately dense (three-card grid with comfortable card padding). Section 4 is compact-structured (2×2 grid, no hero imagery, terminal CTA). This creates a dramatic inhale-exhale rhythm across the page.

RESPONSIVE BEHAVIOR: On tablet, the Section 2 two-column split stacks vertically (illustration card above, text below) with the pull-quote scaling to 48px. The Section 3 three-card grid collapses to a single-column stack. The Section 4 2×2 grid collapses to a single-column stack. The Section 1 masthead remains centered at all breakpoints. The Polished Brass pull-quote in Section 2 always bleeds to the right edge of its container, even on mobile, maintaining the off-grid tension.

section_design_plans.nl_prompt:
PAGE HEADER — Section type: page_header. Surface: Inlaid Cream (#FAF7F2) full-width background. This section is deliberately sparse and masthead-like, functioning as an editorial title page rather than a marketing hero. No card grid, no CTA buttons, no imagery.

LAYOUT: Single centered column, max-width 720px, horizontally centered on the page. Vertical padding: 96px top, 80px bottom. A 1px Brushed Pewter (#8E9199) hairline rule spans the full page width at the very bottom of the section, with a small centered Polished Brass (#B08A4E) diamond ornament (8×8px rotated square) sitting on the rule at its midpoint — this ornamental divider functions as a structural separator, not decoration, and will recur across the page.

EYEBROW: 'Our Story' — Montserrat, all-caps, 11px, letter-spacing 0.16em, Notary Sage (#4A5E52) color. Centered. 24px margin below.

HEADLINE: 'Built on the Belief That Every Family Deserves a Plan' — Libre Baskerville Bold, 52px, sentence case, tracking -0.02em, line-height 1.15, Vault Slate (#2C3340) color. Centered. The headline is allowed to wrap naturally across 2–3 lines within the 720px column. 28px margin below.

SUBHEADLINE: 'Hearthstone Law was founded on the conviction that estate planning is one of the most profound acts of love a person can undertake.' — Source Sans 3, 19px, line-height 1.65, Brushed Pewter (#8E9199) color. Centered. Max-width 560px, horizontally centered within the column.

NO CTA BUTTONS. NO ASSET. The sparseness is intentional — this section earns its breathing room by contrast with the dense dark panel that follows immediately below.

STORY BLOCK — Section type: story_block. This is the PAGE SIGNATURE MOMENT. Full-bleed Vault Slate (#2C3340) background spanning 100vw with no horizontal margin. Vertical padding: 80px top, 80px bottom. The section uses an asymmetric two-column grid split at 44% left / 56% right within a max-width 1200px centered container.

LEFT COLUMN (44%): Contains the skeuomorphic timeline illustration card. The illustration (a stylized milestone ribbon with document-and-seal aesthetic) is rendered as a raised physical artifact: it sits inside a card-shaped container with an Inlaid Cream (#FAF7F2) face, a 1px top and left edge highlight in #FFFFFF at 60% opacity (simulating a lit upper-left edge), and a deep Chambered Shadow (#1A1E26) drop shadow at 24px blur, 8px Y-offset, 0px X-offset. The card has 24px internal padding and 8px border-radius. The card is vertically centered within the left column and positioned slightly overlapping the top edge of the section (translated -32px upward from the section top boundary) so it appears to physically rest across the section boundary from the page header above — reinforcing the skeuomorphic sense of a document placed on a dark desk surface. Card dimensions: approximately 380px wide × 280px tall.

RIGHT COLUMN (56%): Contains the eyebrow, body text, and the oversized pull-quote signature move.

EYEBROW: 'Why We Do This Work' — Montserrat, all-caps, 11px, letter-spacing 0.16em, Brushed Pewter (#8E9199) color. Left-aligned. 32px margin below.

SIGNATURE PULL-QUOTE: Extract the phrase 'Make thoughtful, thorough estate planning accessible to every family' from the body. Render it in Libre Baskerville Regular (not bold — the weight contrast against the dark surface does the work), 72px, line-height 1.1, Polished Brass (#B08A4E) color. Left-aligned. The last word 'family' is allowed to bleed 40px beyond the right edge of the right column container — it clips slightly at the viewport edge on desktop, creating deliberate off-grid tension that is the skeuomorphic-modern signature move. 40px margin below the pull-quote.

BODY COPY: Full paragraph text — 'Founding attorney Eleanor Marsh began her career...' through '...plans in place they can trust.' — Source Sans 3, 17px, line-height 1.65, Inlaid Cream (#FAF7F2) color. Left-aligned within the right column. Max-width 560px. No headline above the body (the pull-quote serves that role). The section headline 'A Practice Born from Personal Experience' is deprioritized: render it in Libre Baskerville Regular, 24px, Brushed Pewter (#8E9199), left-aligned, 16px below the eyebrow and 24px above the pull-quote — functioning as a subheading rather than a dominant H2, so the pull-quote dominates.

RESPONSIVE: On tablet/mobile, left column stacks above right column. Pull-quote scales to 44px on tablet, 34px on mobile. The bleed effect on 'family' is removed on mobile — the word wraps within the column instead.

TEAM GRID — Section type: item_grid. Surface: Hearthstone Linen (#F2EDE6) full-width background. Vertical padding: 80px top, 80px bottom. This section returns to warmth and human scale after the dramatic dark panel. The ornamental Brushed Pewter hairline with Polished Brass diamond ornament appears at the top of this section (same treatment as the Section 1 bottom rule), providing structural continuity.

HEADER BLOCK: Left-aligned within the max-width 1200px container. Eyebrow 'The Team' — Montserrat, all-caps, 11px, letter-spacing 0.16em, Notary Sage (#4A5E52). 20px below. Headline 'Attorneys Who Listen First, Then Plan' — Libre Baskerville Bold, 38px, tracking -0.02em, Vault Slate (#2C3340). 16px below. Subheadline 'Our attorneys combine deep legal expertise with a genuine commitment to understanding each client's unique family situation.' — Source Sans 3, 17px, line-height 1.6, Brushed Pewter (#8E9199). Max-width 640px. 48px margin below the subheadline before the card grid.

CARD GRID: Three attorney profile cards in a horizontal row, equal-width columns with 24px gutters, within the 1200px container. Each card uses the full skeuomorphic material treatment: Inlaid Cream (#FAF7F2) card face, 1px top-edge highlight in #FFFFFF at 70% opacity, 1px left-edge highlight in #FFFFFF at 40% opacity, Polished Brass (#B08A4E) 1.5px border on the top edge only (sitting above the white highlight — this is the 'highlighted edge accent' from the aesthetic), Chambered Shadow (#1A1E26) drop shadow at 16px blur, 6px Y-offset. Card border-radius: 6px. Internal card padding: 32px horizontal, 28px vertical.

EACH CARD INTERIOR (top to bottom):
1. Avatar placeholder: A circular frame, 80px diameter, centered horizontally at the top of the card. Border: 2px Polished Brass (#B08A4E). Background: Brushed Pewter (#8E9199) at 30% opacity (placeholder tone). 24px margin below.
2. Role badge: Montserrat, all-caps, 10px, letter-spacing 0.14em, Notary Sage (#4A5E52). Centered. 8px below.
3. Attorney name: Libre Baskerville Bold, 20px, Vault Slate (#2C3340). Centered. 12px below.
4. Description: Source Sans 3, 15px, line-height 1.6, Brushed Pewter (#8E9199). Left-aligned (not centered — breaks symmetry within the card for a more editorial feel). No bottom CTA per section spec.

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
The Services page for Hearthstone Law is a dense, material-rich composition built around the card-grid layout family and the skeuomorphic-modern aesthetic. The page moves through four sections with deliberate rhythm: a masthead-style page header with typographic authority, a six-card service grid with tactile depth, an asymmetric process story block with an oversized numeral spine, and a full-bleed Polished Brass CTA close. No two sections share the same skeleton.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The six-card service grid (Section 2) contains the page's defining visual move — each card is rendered as a raised, embossed legal document tile. Cards sit on the Hearthstone Linen (#F2EDE6) page surface and are lifted on Inlaid Cream (#FAF7F2) faces with a multi-layered drop shadow using Chambered Shadow (#1A1E26) at low opacity (first layer: 0 2px 4px, second layer: 0 8px 24px) to simulate physical paper lifted off a desk. Each card has a top-edge highlight rule — a 1px line in white at full opacity — simulating light catching a raised edge, and a bottom-edge shadow rule in Chambered Shadow at 15% opacity. The card border is 1.5px solid with a subtle gradient from #C4A06A to #8E7040 (Polished Brass family) on the left edge only, evoking a gilded document binding. This is unmistakably skeuomorphic-modern: material depth, highlighted edges, and object-like surfaces — not decorative, but structural to the grid's identity.

SECTION SEQUENCE AND RHYTHM:
— Section 1 (Page Header): Full-width masthead panel. Vault Slate (#2C3340) background. Libre Baskerville headline at 56px dominates the left column. Eyebrow in Montserrat all-caps Polished Brass. Five small skeuomorphic document icons arranged in a tight horizontal strip on the right column, each rendered as a miniature raised tile. Left-heavy asymmetric split (60/40). Dense typographic weight, minimal vertical padding compared to the card grid below.
— Section 2 (Item Grid): The page's widest, most visually rich section. Hearthstone Linen surface. Six cards in a 3-column grid (collapsing to 2 on tablet, 1 on mobile). Each card is a skeuomorphic raised document tile. This is the densest section with the tightest card spacing (20px gutter) to reinforce the material, stacked-documents feeling.
— Section 3 (Story Block): Breaks the grid entirely. Vault Slate left column (40%) carries an oversized numeral "4" in Libre Baskerville at 280px, set in Polished Brass at 15% opacity as a background typographic watermark behind the four-step process. Right column (60%) carries the body copy in Source Sans 3 on Inlaid Cream surface. Asymmetric, editorial, deliberately sparse after the dense card grid.
— Section 4 (CTA): Full-bleed Polished Brass (#B08A4E) panel. Centered composition — the single instance of symmetry on the page, justified by the heritage-close convention and the need for the accent color to dominate a full surface. Libre Baskerville headline in Inlaid Cream at 44px. Two CTA buttons in contrasting treatments.

COLOR AND SURFACE LOGIC: Page background is Hearthstone Linen. Section 1 breaks to Vault Slate (dark anchor). Section 2 returns to Hearthstone Linen with Inlaid Cream card faces. Section 3 uses a split surface: Vault Slate left, Inlaid Cream right. Section 4 is full Polished Brass — the accent color earns a full-bleed panel here, not just a button. Brushed Pewter (#8E9199) is used throughout for metadata, dividers, and secondary labels.

TYPOGRAPHIC HIERARCHY: Libre Baskerville for all H1/H2/H3 headlines. Montserrat 11px all-caps 0.14em tracking for all eyebrow labels and card category badges. Source Sans 3 16–18px for body and card descriptions. Card "Ideal For" metadata in Montserrat 10px all-caps Brushed Pewter. The oversized "4" watermark in Section 3 is the typographic stunt — Libre Baskerville at display scale used as a background texture, not readable text.

DENSITY LOGIC: Section 1 is moderately dense (masthead weight). Section 2 is the densest (six cards, tight gutter, rich surface detail). Section 3 is deliberately sparse and editorial (breathing room after the grid). Section 4 is clean and focused (conversion moment, no distractions).

RESPONSIVE BEHAVIOR: On mobile, the 3-column card grid collapses to single-column stacked cards. The Section 1 icon strip moves below the headline. The Section 3 split becomes stacked (Vault Slate top with the numeral watermark, Inlaid Cream body below). The Section 4 CTA remains full-bleed with stacked buttons. The skeuomorphic card shadows reduce to a single-layer drop shadow on mobile to avoid rendering weight.

Each card is the page's defining material object. Specifications:

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
The Articles page for Hearthstone Law functions as a curated editorial library — warm, authoritative, and materially rich. The page must feel like a well-organized reference room rather than a blog feed: tactile surfaces, clear typographic hierarchy, and the skeuomorphic depth system working at full amplitude across every section.

SECTION SEQUENCE AND RHYTHM:
Section 1 (Page Header) opens with a masthead-style, asymmetric header — dense type on the left, generous negative space on the right — establishing the editorial register immediately. Section 2 (Article List / Featured Articles) is the densest section: a 3×2 card grid of article cards with material depth, elevated surfaces, and brass-accented category badges. Section 3 (Browse by Topic / Feature Grid) shifts to a 2×2 tile grid with a side-label navigation feel — each tile is a wide, horizontally oriented panel rather than a square card, creating a different rhythm from Section 2. Section 4 (CTA) closes with a full-bleed Vault Slate dark panel, centered composition, and a single Polished Brass button — the one moment of symmetry on the page, structurally justified as the closing anchor.

SIGNATURE MOMENT:
The page's signature moment lives in Section 2. The section headline "Start Here: The Essentials of Estate Planning" is set at oversized display scale — Libre Baskerville at approximately 52–58px — and the word "Essentials" is rendered in Polished Brass (#B08A4E) while the remaining words stay in Vault Slate (#2C3340). This single-word brass accent bleeds slightly beyond the standard grid column into the gutter on the right, creating a typographic stunt that is unmistakably skeuomorphic-modern: the warm metallic accent behaves like a gilded inlay on a document, not a SaaS highlight. The oversized brass word anchors the entire card grid below it and signals that this section is the editorial heart of the page. The skeuomorphic open-book icon asset sits to the right of this headline, slightly overlapping the first row of cards, reinforcing the depth layering.

COLOR AND SURFACE USAGE:
Page background: Hearthstone Linen (#F2EDE6) — the warm off-white base throughout. Section 1 header panel: Inlaid Cream (#FAF7F2) as a slightly elevated surface, separated from the page background by a 1px Brushed Pewter rule and a subtle drop shadow (Chambered Shadow at low opacity) beneath the panel edge. Section 2 article cards: Inlaid Cream card faces with Chambered Shadow drop shadows and Polished Brass border highlights on the top edge (2px) to simulate a gilded card edge — the skeuomorphic material signature. Category badge backgrounds: Notary Sage (#4A5E52) for text labels in Montserrat. Section 3 topic tiles: Vault Slate (#2C3340) as the tile background with Inlaid Cream text — a deliberate dark-surface flip that breaks the linen monotony and adds visual weight to the mid-page. Section 4 CTA: Full-bleed Chambered Shadow (#1A1E26) background, the darkest surface on the page, with Inlaid Cream heading and Polished Brass CTA button.

TYPOGRAPHIC HIERARCHY:
Eyebrow labels: Montserrat 11px, all-caps, 0.15em letter-spacing, Notary Sage on light surfaces, Brushed Pewter on dark surfaces. Section headings: Libre Baskerville, bold, sentence case, -0.02em tracking. H1-equivalent in Section 1: 48px Vault Slate. Display headline in Section 2: 52–58px with the Polished Brass "Essentials" word treatment. Section 3 headline: 36px Inlaid Cream on Vault Slate. Section 4 headline: 40px Inlaid Cream on Chambered Shadow. Body / card descriptions: Source Sans 3, 16px, 1.65 line-height, Vault Slate on light, Inlaid Cream on dark. Card titles: Libre Baskerville 20px bold. Metadata labels: Montserrat 10px all-caps Brushed Pewter.

DENSITY AND WHITESPACE LOGIC:
Section 1 is deliberately sparse — wide top padding (80px), the headline breathes with generous line-height, and the right column is largely empty, creating a masthead-like editorial opener. Section 2 is the page's densest zone — the 3×2 card grid fills the full 12-column grid with 24px gutters and cards that have 28px internal padding, creating a rich, tactile surface arrangement. Section 3 is medium-density — four wide horizontal tiles stacked in a 2-column grid with 20px gutters, each tile carrying icon-equivalent left-anchored numbering. Section 4 is sparse and ceremonial — centered, wide padding (96px top/bottom), minimal content, maximum weight.

RESPONSIVE BEHAVIOR:
At tablet (768–1024px): Section 2 card grid collapses to 2 columns (3 rows). Section 3 tiles collapse to 1 column (4 rows). Section 1 asymmetric split collapses to full-width single column. At mobile (<768px): All grids go single column. The Section 2 brass display headline wraps gracefully — "Essentials" remains in Polished Brass regardless of wrap. The skeuomorphic card depth (shadow, top-edge brass border) is preserved at all breakpoints. CTA section padding reduces to 64px top/bottom.

SHARED DESIGN SYSTEM FIT:
This page uses all seven palette colors in meaningful roles, employs all three typefaces in their correct registers, and applies the skeuomorphic depth system (elevated surfaces, Chambered Shadow drop shadows, highlighted edges, material layering) consistently. The card grid layout family is expressed through the 3×2 article grid and 2×2 topic tile grid, with varied card shapes and orientations preventing repetition.

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
**Book a Consultation — Page-Level Design Direction**

**Page Role & Tone**
This is the conversion terminus of the Hearthstone Law site. Every design decision must reduce friction, reinforce trust, and make the act of booking feel like a natural, unhurried next step rather than a transactional form-fill. The skeuomorphic_modern aesthetic is expressed here through material depth — layered card surfaces, inset shadows, highlighted metallic edges, and tactile form controls — while the card_grid layout family structures the feature and testimonial sections into dense, legible tile arrangements.

**Section Sequence & Rhythm**
1. **Page Header (book-section-1):** Masthead-style, asymmetric, dark-anchored panel — Vault Slate surface, large serif headline left-aligned, calendar illustration right-anchored. Dense and grounded. Sets authority.
2. **Contact Block (book-section-2):** The page's heaviest and most interactive section. Split into a left editorial column (method cards stacked vertically) and a right booking form panel raised on Inlaid Cream. Maximum material depth. Polished Brass highlighted edges on the form card. This is the conversion engine.
3. **Feature Grid (book-section-3):** A four-column card grid on Hearthstone Linen — open, airy, and reassuring. Sparse rhythm after the dense contact block. Notary Sage accent icons. Numbered oversized display numerals (1–4) in Polished Brass anchor each card — this is a structural typographic move that gives the grid personality without decoration.
4. **Testimonial (book-section-4):** A dense, materially rich closing panel. Chambered Shadow surface with Inlaid Cream card insets for two quotes. Ends the page with warmth and finality before the persistent footer.

**Signature Moment**
The page's signature moment lives in **Section 2 (Contact Block)**: the booking form is rendered as a skeuomorphic document card — a raised Inlaid Cream panel with a subtle ruled-paper texture suggestion (achieved through fine 1px horizontal dividers between form field rows in Brushed Pewter at 20% opacity), a Polished Brass highlighted top edge (4px solid border-top), and deep Chambered Shadow drop shadow (0 8px 32px rgba(26,30,38,0.22)). The three consultation method selectors (Phone, Video, In-Person) are rendered as skeuomorphic toggle-style cards — pill-shaped selectors with a metallic inset shadow on inactive state and a Polished Brass border + Inlaid Cream fill on selected state — evoking physical radio buttons on a printed form. This is the inevitable skeuomorphic move for a conversion page: the form itself becomes a beautiful, tactile document you want to fill out, not a generic web input.

**Color & Surface Logic**
- Section 1: Vault Slate background, Inlaid Cream headline, Brushed Pewter subheadline, Polished Brass eyebrow label.
- Section 2: Hearthstone Linen page background, left column on transparent/linen, right form card on Inlaid Cream with Polished Brass top-edge accent and Chambered Shadow drop shadow. Polished Brass CTA button. Method selector cards on Hearthstone Linen with Brushed Pewter border inactive / Polished Brass border active.
- Section 3: Hearthstone Linen background. Cards on Inlaid Cream. Polished Brass oversized numerals. Notary Sage icon marks. Vault Slate card headings. Brushed Pewter body text.
- Section 4: Chambered Shadow background. Two testimonial cards on Inlaid Cream with Polished Brass left border accent (4px). Inlaid Cream quote text. Brushed Pewter attribution. Notary Sage decorative opening quotation mark (oversized, 80px, behind quote text).

**Typographic Hierarchy**
- Display: Libre Baskerville Bold, 48–52px, sentence case, tight tracking (-0.02em) — Section 1 headline.
- H2: Libre Baskerville Regular, 32–36px — Section 2 and 3 headlines.
- H3: Libre Baskerville Regular, 22px — card titles throughout.
- Eyebrows: Montserrat, 11px, all-caps, 0.15em letter-spacing, Polished Brass.
- Body: Source Sans 3, 16–17px, 1.65 line-height, Vault Slate on light / Inlaid Cream on dark.
- Oversized numerals (Section 3): Libre Baskerville Bold, 64px, Polished Brass, 0.6 opacity — positioned top-left of each card as a structural anchor.
- Metadata / labels: Montserrat, 10–11px, all-caps, Brushed Pewter.

**Density & Whitespace Logic**
Dense → Conversion-dense → Open → Warm-dense. Section 1 is tight and authoritative (48px vertical padding). Section 2 is the densest (form, method cards, editorial text — 72px vertical padding, complex internal grid). Section 3 breathes with generous card padding (40px internal) and 64px section padding. Section 4 is emotionally warm and moderately dense (56px vertical padding, two large quote cards).

**Responsive Behavior**
- Section 1: Stacks to single column on mobile; illustration moves above headline at mobile breakpoint.
- Section 2: Left editorial column collapses above form card on tablet; form card goes full-width on mobile; method selectors stack vertically.
- Section 3: 4-col grid → 2-col at tablet → 1-col at mobile. Oversized numerals remain visible at all breakpoints.
- Section 4: 2-col testimonial cards → 1-col stacked on mobile.

**Cross-Page Fit**
This page completes the site's journey: Home establishes trust, About deepens it, Services clarifies options, Articles educates, and Book converts. The material richness of the skeuomorphic form card is the payoff of the design system's promise — every surface texture and highlighted edge the visitor has seen across the site culminates in a booking form that feels as trustworthy and crafted as the firm itself.
